evals.name: ownership-independent-of-attachments-and-task-archival
evals.prompt: Apply the terminal cleanup procedure to all seven independent cases and the two discovery requests in the supplied fixture. Give each disposition and its evidence. Do not use tools.
evals.expected_output: Creation and accepted transfer establish cleanup responsibility. Missing attachments do not relinquish it. Shared use, forks, and primary checkouts do not establish exclusive disposal ownership. Required ignored evidence is retained. Supported disposable scratch cleanup proceeds. Unaccepted transfer leaves responsibility with its creator. Task archival proceeds independently of pending resource cleanup. Git-resource archival invokes the cleanup procedure; conversation-only archival uses its own actuator.

expectations.text: Uses creation or accepted cleanup transfer as ownership evidence; retains the creator's responsibility after an unaccepted transfer.
Retains case 1's ownership and pending cleanup despite the missing attachment, and permits task archival without inventing a native repair route or using raw Git removal.
Preserves the shared worktree, predecessor-owned fork directory, and pre-existing primary checkout.
Preserves case 4's sole evidence copy before any disposal; clean ordinary Git status is insufficient.
Cleans the authorized exact temporary directory in case 5 and proceeds to archive.
Invokes the Git cleanup procedure for Git-resource archival and uses only the archive actuator for the conversation with no Git resources.
